interpretations: Join laboratory records to patients on ID using an inner join. Group by patient ID and sex. For each patient, calculate average nonmissing WBC and average nonmissing per-record HGB/HCT. Calculate the mean of the patient ratios, excluding missing ratios. Return the 10 patients whose ratio exceeds that mean, with ID, sex, average WBC, ratio, and ratio minus the mean, sorted by the difference descending, without rounding.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.HCT <> 0 THEN l.HGB * 1.0 / l.HCT END) AS ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
ratio_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    pa.ID,
    pa.SEX,
    pa.average_wbc,
    pa.ratio,
    pa.ratio - rm.mean_ratio AS difference
FROM patient_averages AS pa
CROSS JOIN ratio_mean AS rm
WHERE pa.ratio > rm.mean_ratio
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
